qoder.note: Known working direct API. scrape_usage.py --platform qoder already calls this via page.evaluate(fetch) with cookie auth.

codebuddy.note: Verified direct API (CodeBuddy web console). Works out of the box once the Chrome session cookies are cached; run --discover only if the endpoint/body changes.

deepseek.note: Export API unknown (web console also offers a downloadable zip). Run with --discover once, or keep using the file-export path (drop the zip into raw/).

trae.note: Export-only: no known direct usage API yet. Keep using the file-export path (drop the usage export into raw/) or run --discover to capture the real endpoint as a live override.
